title: Contrasting Angles
summary: Drop the daylight on a building sporting black walls and white balconies, particularly one where the balconies are arranged in an increasingly staggered pattern as the building rises higher into the dark night air, and you have a recipe for a high-contrast treat, one that's improved by the odd white lights with a different colour temperature from the bulk, and the even rarer coloured light!
